typewriterLines: I train language models from scratch.
From Kathmandu to Hildesheim — shipping ML.
about: I build ML systems end-to-end — from pretraining transformer architectures on raw corpora to deploying analytics pipelines in production. My research at NAAMII focused on imbalanced clinical cancer data, resulting in a published IEEE paper on radiation pneumonitis prediction using multi-omics approaches.

On the engineering side, I've shipped ML solutions for real businesses, designed medallion-architecture data pipelines, and automated analytical workflows using LLM-based agents. My flagship project, PIGPT-60M, is a 60-million parameter GPT I designed, trained, and fine-tuned entirely from scratch.
I'm currently pursuing my MSc in Data Analytics at the University of Hildesheim. Originally from Nepal, now based in Germany — chasing hard problems in AI and building things that actually work.

projects.name: PIGPT-60M
projects.tagline: GPT architecture. 60M parameters. Built from scratch.
projects.description: Designed and trained a 60-million parameter GPT-style language model end-to-end on Kaggle GPUs. Full pipeline: pretraining on TinyStories corpus, fine-tuned on Alpaca + DailyDialog + GSM8K for instruction following and conversational capability. No pretrained weights — everything from scratch.
